questions.stem_text: The appropriate fiscal policy to remedy a recession is to

options.B: reduce government spending and increase taxes.
options.C: increase taxes without changing government spending.
options.D: maintain current levels of government spending and taxes.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - increase government spending and taxes.

questions.stem_text: Why did theinstitutionalistsof the early twentieth century reject laissez-faire?

options.A: They held the view that government intervention would reduce economic freedom.
options.B: They were convinced that laissez-faire would ensure equitable wealth distribution.
options.C: They were disturbed by the wide spread poverty and the fluctuations of the business cycle.
options.D: They thought laissez-faire would lead to more efficient and ethical business practices.
options.E: They favored the principles of socialism.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - They were disturbed by the wide spread poverty and the fluctuations of the business cycle.
